tooltip.idle: Click to open Flexa music player

panel.title: Flexa

empty.no-dir: Set a music folder in settings to start playing.
empty.no-tracks: No audio files found in the configured folder.
empty.no-queue: Queue is empty. Play a song or add tracks with +.
empty.no-favorites: No liked tracks yet. Tap the heart on any song.

panel.select-track: Choose a track below to start listening

music-directory.label: Music folder
music-directory.description: Folder containing your audio files (supports ~/ paths).

recursive-scan.label: Scan subfolders
recursive-scan.description: Include audio files inside nested artist and album folders.

default-volume.label: Startup volume
default-volume.description: Initial player volume (0-100%) when no saved volume exists.

remember-last-track.label: Remember last session
remember-last-track.description: Restore the last played track, volume, shuffle, and repeat mode.

extract-artwork.label: Extract album art
extract-artwork.description: Cache folder artwork and embedded covers using ffmpeg when available.

show-bar-controls.label: Bar mini-controls
show-bar-controls.description: Show inline play/pause and next-track buttons on the bar widget.

show-bar-title.label: Show track in bar
show-bar-title.description: Display the current track title next to the Flexa icon in the bar.

show-bar-artwork.label: Show cover art in bar
show-bar-artwork.description: Replace the bar music icon with the current track's album art when playing.

bar-max-width.label: Bar title max width
bar-max-width.description: Maximum width in logical pixels for the track title in the bar.
